items.title: Nicki Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe. Utica, New York, November 6, 2010 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: my sister leaves today to go on a jazz cruise with Diva

ctx.x: Yeah. Well I guess it gets into the marketing thing. I mean I think it’s hard enough for a big band to get work. In fact my sister leaves today to go on a jazz cruise with Diva. Anyway, I think if you’ve been around for ten years and you get gigs with the name Diva and it’s working for you then why change it. I mean it’s hard enough with a name change to try to get gigs. I think it works for them. You know they are kind of a Diva-ish kind of band. You know what I mean? They really sock it to you. They’re a really…
So the name does have some significance behind it. Because the word “Diva” is used a lot these days. © Fillius Jazz Archive -16-
Yeah it’s overused and it’s usually in reference to a woman who thinks she’s all that or whatever. You know what I mean? But I think it’s fine for the band. And they sound good.
